entries.title: 二氧化碳排放量
entries.prompt: The graph below shows average carbon dioxide (CO₂) emissions per person in the United Kingdom, Sweden, Italy and Portugal between 1967 and 2007. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
entries.meaning: 下图显示了1967年至2007年英国、瑞典、意大利和葡萄牙的人均二氧化碳（CO₂）排放情况。请通过挑选和报告主要特征来总结信息，并在相关情况下进行比较。
entries.draftHtml:
The line chart shows average carbon dioxide emissions per person in four countries in a 40-year period.
From 1967 to 2007, the United Kingdom had released the most carbon dioxide and Portugal stayed at the lowest position.
In 1967, each person in the United Kingdom emitted about 11 metric tonnes while the number in Portugal is only about 1, almost at a negligible level. At the same time, Swedish produced just over 8 metric tonnes and Italian's personal emision is approximately 4 metric tonnes.
During the next 10 years, the emission in Italy, Sweden and Portugal remained a rising trend, while in the United Kingdom it decreasesl with time. In 1977, the personal emission in Sweden reached its peak of about 10.5 metric tonnes. After that, it declined while the other 3 countries remained the same trend as before. Italy overtook Sweden in 1987 and other ranks were identical as the beginning. Finally in 2007, all the countries reached a level below 10 metric tonnes.
entries.modelHtml:
The line chart depicts changes in average per capita carbon dioxide emissions in the United Kingdom, Sweden, Italy, and Portugal from 1967 to 2007.

Overall, the UK consistently had the highest emissions for most of the period, while Portugal recorded the lowest levels. Sweden experienced a notable rise and subsequent fall, whereas Italy showed a steady upward trend.

In 1967, the UK emitted roughly 11 metric tonnes per person, far exceeding the other three countries. Sweden followed with about 8.5 tonnes, while Italy and Portugal produced much lower figures, at approximately 4 and 1 tonne respectively.

Over the next decade, emissions in Italy, Sweden, and Portugal climbed, but the UK’s declined gradually. Sweden peaked at around 10.5 tonnes in 1977, after which it dropped sharply, ending at about 5.5 tonnes in 2007. Meanwhile, Italy’s emissions continued to rise, overtaking Sweden in 1987 and finishing at nearly 7.5 tonnes. Portugal’s emissions also increased, reaching about 5 tonnes by the end of the period, similar to Sweden’s final figure. The UK, despite its falling trend, remained the highest emitter at approximately 8.5 tonnes in 2007. All four countries ended with per capita emissions below 10 metric tonnes.

bank.sentences: While ... experienced a sharp increase, ... showed a gradual decrease.
bank.keyNotes: 描述折线图时，时态一律用一般过去时；使用“the figure/emissions for + 国家”而非“country’s personal emission”。
bank.trendPhrases:
above / exceed / surpass / overtake 超过；在……之上
peak at / surge to a peak of 到达……的顶峰
show a rising / upward trend 呈现上升趋势

corrections.comment: 意为微不足道的，虽然1从数字上来说很小，但是单位是吨，对于每人来说用该词不太合适。

corrections.source: reached a level below 10 metric tonnes
corrections.fix: emissions in all four countries had fallen to below 10 tonnes, with the UK and Italy at roughly 9 and 7 tonnes respectively, while Sweden and Portugal recorded around 6 and 5 tonnes
corrections.comment: 作为结尾，仅陈述 “都低于10” 过于单薄，没有把具体数值交代清楚，缺乏有效的数据对比作为收束。

corrections.source: the United Kingdom had released the most carbon dioxide
corrections.fix: the United Kingdom emitted the most carbon dioxide
corrections.comment: 过去完成时多余，这里只需一般过去时描述当时事实；同时“had released”强调先后顺序，但此处不适用。

corrections.source: the United Kingdom had released the most carbon dioxide
corrections.fix: the United Kingdom had the highest carbon dioxide emissions
corrections.comment: “release”可用于排放，但更常用“emit”，且“had the highest emissions”更符合图表描述习惯。

corrections.source: Portugal stayed at the lowest position
corrections.comment: “stay at position”不够地道，描述排名常用“remain the lowest”或“have the lowest emissions”。

corrections.source: while the number in Portugal is only about 1
corrections.fix: while the figure for Portugal was only about 1 metric tonne
corrections.comment: 时态不一致（前文emitted过去，这里is现在）；“number”指代不明，应改用“figure”或“emissions per person”。

corrections.source: the emission in Italy, Sweden and Portugal remained a rising trend
corrections.fix: emissions in Italy, Sweden, and Portugal showed a rising trend
corrections.comment: “remained a rising trend”搭配不当，趋势上升应说“showed an upward trend”或“increased”；另外“emission”常用复数“emissions”。

corrections.source: while in the United Kingdom it decreased with time
corrections.fix: while those in the United Kingdom decreased over time
corrections.comment: “it”指代不明（前面emission单数，但英国也是排放量，用“those”指代复数emissions更准确）；“with time”虽可，但“over time”更标准。

corrections.source: After that, it declined while the other 3 countries remained the same trend as before.
corrections.fix: After that, Sweden's emissions fell, whereas Italy and Portugal continued to rise, and the UK kept decreasing.
corrections.comment: 原文说“其他三国保持相同趋势”与事实不符，实际上只有意大利和葡萄牙持续上升，英国下降，瑞典下降，因此逻辑错误，需要清晰区分各国走势。

entries.stance:
审题要点：本题为动态折线图，需描述四个国家在40年间的变化，重点抓整体趋势（上升/下降/波动）、极值（最高/最低）和交叉点（意大利超过瑞典）。

结构蓝图：
开头段-改写题目，点明图表类型、时间、对象。
概述段-概括最显著特征——英国始终最高但持续下降，瑞典先升后降，意大利持续上升，葡萄牙最低但上升。
细节段：按时间顺序（1967→1977→1987→2007）分段描述，同时比较各国数值和排名变化，尤其强调意大利与瑞典的交叉。
结尾可总结终值情况（所有国家均低于10吨）。
entries.arguments:
论证技法：采用“先总体后具体”和“纵向比较（时间）与横向比较（国家）”结合。
实操建议：

开头句避免重复题目，可用“The line chart illustrates...”或“The given graph shows...”。

概述段不列举具体数字，只提取最高、最低、最大变化等宏观特征。

细节段每组数据后尽量加上对比句（如“...while...”、“...compared with...”）。

使用多样化的趋势动词（increase, rise, climb, drop, decline, fall, level off, fluctuate）和程度副词（sharply, steadily, gradually, slightly）。

注意时态统一为一般过去时，所有数据点描述均用过去时。

evaluation.title: 亮点
evaluation.body: 开头清晰指明了图表类型、时间跨度和四个国家，结尾给出了2007年的整体结论，整体结构完整。

evaluation.title: 短板
evaluation.body: 数据描述不够准确，关键转折点（瑞典1977年后下降、意大利持续上升）交代含糊；时态和搭配错误较多，影响信息传达的清晰度。

evaluation.title: 提升路径
evaluation.body: 严格统一使用过去时（图表为过去数据），纠正搭配（如用“showed an upward trend”替代“remained a rising trend”），并在描述国家数据时使用“the figure for + 国家”或“country’s emissions”，避免中式表达。

preferences.examSummary:
大作文：先判断题型，再决定段落任务。单边讨论要立场清晰，双边讨论要两边都回应，问题措施要原因和措施对应，复合问题要逐问回答。

小作文：先写总览，再分组写细节。不要一上来堆数字，先看最高、最低、变化最大、趋势相反。

考前提醒：少写空泛词，多写具体动作；注意 government / environment / convenient / comparison 这些易错拼写。
